BiblicalUsage: Bazaz means to plunder, to spoil, to take the goods of the defeated. The sons of Jacob spoil Shechem, Israel takes the spoil of Ai at God's command, the people spoil the Syrian camp at Samaria when the lepers find it empty, and the Jews are given leave to plunder their enemies on the day of their deliverance.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe plunder in Scripture is always God's verdict on who won, because the spoil goes to the side He has given the victory to. The lepers found a camp God had emptied, and I hold that the spoil of Samaria is the proof that God fights for His people even when they are starving inside their own walls.
